name: DICOM Viewer: Raykin
description:
Raykin opens the scans hospitals give you — copied from a CD, on a USB drive, in a ZIP file or behind a QR code — and keeps your family's X-ray, CT, MRI and ultrasound images in one private place on your Android phone, tablet and Wear OS watch. Your scans stay on your device: no account, nothing uploaded.

OPEN WHAT THE HOSPITAL GAVE YOU
• Files, folders, ZIP and DICOMDIR from your phone, Google Drive or a USB-C drive
• Hospital QR codes and links: DICOM and ZIP files download straight into Raykin
• Got a CD? Copy the disc to a USB drive on any computer, then import the drive
• A photo of an old film, or a scanned paper report (text recognised on your device)
• Scans are sorted into people and visits for you

SEE IT CLEARLY
• Scroll through slices, adjust brightness and contrast with presets, zoom, rotate and invert
• Play ultrasound and other moving images
• Compare up to 4 images, with cross-reference lines and a mini-map
• The hospital's saved views and marks, shown as saved
• A plain-language Series Explainer and glossary: what an MRI sequence or CT series shows
• Show the Doctor: one visit full screen; leaving it needs your fingerprint, face or screen lock

KEEP TRACK
• Star key images and keep notes
• Follow-up reminders with a checklist of questions for the doctor
• An Imaging Notes card for implants, allergies and past contrast reactions, also on your watch

UNLOCK MORE, FREE
Watch two short ads to use any of these for 24 hours:
• Then & Now: compare two dates side by side, with flicker and blend, kept in position
• Pro Tools: measurements in mm, angles, areas and CT density (HU), multi-image layouts, MPR in any plane and 3D volume rendering
• Clean Share: a copy without names, IDs or birth dates, dates shifted, burned-in text flagged for you to cover — as a ZIP, images, a video or a second-opinion PDF packet
• Unlimited family members (2 are always included) and per-person lock
• Smart Search in plain words
Everything is free on the built-in sample family.

ON YOUR ANDROID DEVICES
• Phones, tablets and foldables, with layouts for large screens
• Wear OS watch app, used with Raykin on your phone: the next follow-up with questions, Imaging Notes and the key images you choose
• Wear OS tile: the Next follow-up tile shows the days until your next follow-up; tap it to open the watch app
• Home-screen widgets for your family, the next follow-up, recent visits and key images
• Nearby Transfer between your own Android devices, end-to-end encrypted, never through the internet
• Encrypted Raykin Archive backups with your own passphrase
• 12 languages: English (US), English (UK), Tiếng Việt, Español, Português (Brasil), Deutsch, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文 and 繁體中文 — switch inside the app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Fingerprint or face lock, per-person lock, hidden details on widgets and the watch, and scans hidden from Recents and screenshots. Raykin is free and shows ads from Google AdMob; ads never see your scans. In the EU, UK and Switzerland you choose how ads use your data.

Terms of Use: https://orlproducts.com/raykin-terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://orlproducts.com/raykin-privacy.html

For viewing only. Raykin is not a medical device and is not intended for diagnosis or treatment. Always ask your doctor about your results.
